assumptions: The existing 460/480/500/520-kg/m3 density trials are sensitivities around the current 500-kg/m3 mass prior, not observed mean densities or physical extrema. NDS assigned G=0.50 is a separate quantity.

EC5 Kser=rho_mean^1.5*d/23 is a wood dowel service-slip reference per fastener and shear plane. The source describes approximately 40% of maximum load and separate clearance travel. It is not assigned to each current wood/steel/mixed joint.
NDS gamma=180000*D^1.5 lb/in is used only as the wood-to-wood group-action reference for the sixteen current ordinary wood/wood axes. It is not a universal 3D spring law.

E_steel=205000 MPa follows the published axial-series study. EA/L uses the own modeled head-to-nut pressure-face distance and full nominal-body/full purchase-root circles as sensitivities. It excludes head and thread equivalent lengths, washers, seats, wood, preload and gaps; no delivered free length or complete joint stiffness is claimed.

The own full-root sensitivities reuse the current purchase-reference floors: 7.31774 mm on 96 nominal9.525-mm axes and9.9949 mm on four nominal12.7-mm starting leg axes. They are not adopted full-thread hardware or new strength checks. Selected partially threaded hardware and the existing non-adopted full-thread strength exceedance remain unchanged.
Combining the steel scalar with two existing 1000-N/mm captures is a one-dimensional illustrative series model, not the current full frame operator or a physical demand bound.

Summed own wood-bearing quadrature springs quantify a uniform-translation foundation integral. That integral is not complete relative joint slip because shaft bending and other member compliances remain.

The Kelvin-compliance Rayleigh enclosure bounds normal modulus only within the existing unmeasured orthotropic scenario, for every direction and material rotation. E_normal divided by the 1-N/mm3 bedding prior gives an implied homogeneous compression depth, not a calibrated contact depth or lower physical stiffness.

Axial seats, pressure/prying, timber contact, local brittle behavior, finished-member stiffness, panel/attachment restraint and finite response remain outside the scalar reference proof. No stiffness is changed or qualified and no current frame cases are repeated.

Retain all current source fields and false acceptance flags. No geometry change, native or frame solve, CAD rebuild, actual observation, floor-friction test, panel/screw remedy, archive or prune is authorized by this record.
